text: Every team has had this moment: wait, didn't we already decide not to do that? Decisions live in meeting notes and decision pages. Months later, new work, or an AI coding agent, quietly undoes them. Precedent gives your team, and your agents, a memory of what has already been decided.

There is no new process. Teams keep typing slash decision in their meeting notes and decision pages, or start a Jira comment with Decision. Precedent captures every decision, with its owner, date, rationale and source, and shows right on the page which Jira work contradicts it.

Here is a new work item: move the payout ledger to MongoDB. Precedent checked it the moment it was written. It contradicts D E C one: keep all transactional payment data in PostgreSQL. It shows the exact sentence that tripped the guardrail, who decided, when, and where.

It works live. Here is a brand new work item: integrate Adyen for EU card payments. The moment it is created, Precedent flags it against the decision to standardize on Stripe, owned by Dana Kim. And it understands direction: removing MongoDB from the refunds service is aligned with the decision, not a conflict.

Ask Precedent hands the context to the Rovo agent. It explains why the decision was made, who to talk to, and the options: comply, log an exception with a reason, or supersede the decision. Every answer cites the decision and its source.

Leads get a Decision Radar for every project: the open conflicts, the evidence, and who is affected. And every result is indexed, so precedent conflicts greater than zero works in J Q L, filters and dashboards.

Because Precedent exposes the same actions through Atlassian's MCP server, AI coding agents check team decisions before they write code. Here, Claude Code calls check work item, finds D E C one, and proposes a compliant design instead. An open source skill file teaches any coding agent to do this by default.
Everything lives in one decision log, in Confluence and Jira, with editable guardrails, history, exceptions and supersession, plus one click sample content, so a new team sees value in a minute.
Precedent. One Forge app across Jira, Confluence, Rovo and MCP, so your team, and your agents, know what has already been decided.
